L10.drivers: Same body plan as L05: blocky waistless trunk, huge shoulder shelf, very wide pelvis, short thick bowed legs with flexed knees, oversized feet, massive forearms and fists

L11.drivers: Same body plan as L03: narrow shoulders and pelvis, deep keeled torso in profile with strong front/back swelling and waist pinch, long thin arms, knobby knees and bulging calves on thin shanks

distinguishing_features: L05/L10 are defined by bulk plus organization: waistless rectangular trunk, huge shoulder shelf, very wide pelvis, short bowed flexed legs, giant feet and fists. L03/L11 are the opposite: narrow shoulders and pelvis, a deep keel-shaped torso with sharp waist inflection seen in profile, long thin arms and knobby knees with bulging calves. The L03/L11 group is less certain; it could be read as an extremely thin human variant (B), but the profile torso shape and joint transitions point to a different body plan.
